{{Nihongo|Van|バーン|Bān}} is a character in ''[[Harvest Moon: DS]] ''and ''[[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]]''.

Van is a traveling salesman who appears in the valley on every date that ends in a 3 or 8 (e.g. 3rd, 8th, 13th, 18th, 23rd 28th, etc.).

He is the only merchant in the valley who will sell items not found in stores, such as DVDs for your television. He will also allow the player to sell non-shippable items to him.

He sets up [[Van's Shop (DS)|shop]] at the Inn on the top floor. He will set up shop during the day and leave during the evening. He will sometimes go to visit the Villa before leaving the valley.
